stories.title: Consent Schema and Tier Contract Definition
stories.description: Define and enforce Pydantic schemas and internal contracts for consent tiers, including Tier 1 (de-identified) and Tier 2 (identified) data structures, validation rules, and transition states.

stories.title: Consent API Endpoints and Tool Exposure
stories.description: Expose consent workflow through backend APIs and tool router, enabling consent capture, upgrade to Tier 2, and status retrieval for downstream services and chat interactions.

stories.title: Consent Workflow Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Implement unit and integration tests validating consent tier enforcement, de-identification, upgrade/downgrade flows, and cross-service enforcement boundaries.
